site.name: Editz
site.tagline: Edit video, audio and images in your browser.

home.title: Edit media without uploading it
home.subtitle: Thirty-odd tools for video, audio and images. Most of them run on your device, so your files stay with you and the work costs you nothing in data.
home.pitchBody: Every other site uploads your file before it will even show you a preview. Editz does the work on your device wherever it possibly can, and when it cannot, it tells you how many megabytes that will cost before you commit.

tools.indexDescription: Every Editz tool. Most run entirely in your browser.

tool.notYetAvailable: Processing arrives in the next release
tool.notYetAvailableBody: The tool pages, settings and the data meter are live. The engine that does the work lands next.
tool.retention: Nothing is kept longer than 24 hours, and files processed on your device are never uploaded at all.
tool.wrongType: That file type is not supported here. This tool takes {types}.

meter.title: Data meter
meter.noFile: Choose a file and this will tell you exactly where the work happens and what it costs you.

reason.client-capable: This runs in your browser. Your file is not uploaded.
reason.tool-is-client-only: This runs in your browser. Nothing is ever uploaded.
reason.file-too-large: This file is too large to process in the browser, so it goes to our servers.
reason.low-device-memory: This device does not have enough memory for a file this size, so it goes to our servers.
reason.tool-is-server-only: This tool runs on our servers — the model it needs is far too large for a browser.
reason.params-need-server: These settings are too heavy for the browser, so this one goes to our servers.
reason.no-cross-origin-isolation: Your browser cannot run this locally, so it goes to our servers.

note.cut-is-keyframe-aligned: This cut copies the video untouched, so it lands on the nearest keyframe — up to a couple of seconds before the point you chose. Switch to an exact cut if the precise frame matters.
note.container-forces-video-reencode: The .{container} format can't carry this video track as it is, so the picture has to be re-encoded. That takes much longer than a straight format change.
note.container-forces-audio-reencode: The .{container} format can't carry this audio track as it is, so the sound has to be re-encoded.
note.codec-not-valid-in-container: {codec} isn't valid inside .{container}, so {using} is being used instead.
note.filter-forces-reencode: The changes you picked mean the picture has to be re-encoded rather than copied across.
note.dimensions-rounded-to-even: This video has an odd width or height. It will be trimmed by one pixel, which the encoder requires.
note.crop-clamped-to-frame: The crop box reached past the edge of the picture, so it has been pulled back to fit.
note.buffers-whole-file: This one holds the whole file in memory at once, so it needs more room than usual and long files go to our servers.

error.range-invalid: That range doesn't look right. Check the start and end times.
error.range-empty: The selected range is empty. Move the start and end apart to choose a clip.
error.range-starts-after-end: The range starts after the end of this file.
error.scale-needs-a-dimension: Enter a width or a height.
error.single-input-expected: This tool takes one file at a time.
error.unsupported-operation: Those settings can't be combined yet.

footer.retention: Files processed on our servers are deleted within 24 hours. Files processed on your device are never uploaded.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: The core tools are free and always will be. Pro pays for the servers that do the heavy work.
